scenarios.scenario: confirmation expiry at two minutes sends no request
duplicate in-flight clicks send one auth and one delete
navigation before confirmation discards secrets without requests
malformed auth identity cannot delete and temporary session is revoked
malformed authentication invalid JSON never deletes
malformed deletion flags never display confirmed
navigation during uncommitted delete revokes temporary session only

limits: No public endpoint, physical accessibility, real account or store qualification.
Expiry uses Playwright virtual browser timer; HTTP operations are actual isolated loopback.
Malformed responses and held navigation request are explicit browser-route fault injection.
